shortDescription: Create and manage the services of cloud Load Balancers on the Hetzner Cloud.

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_endpoint_hetzner
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner API. You can also set this option by using the C(HETZNER_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: The token for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: destination_port
options.description: The port traffic is forwarded to, i.e. the port the targets are listening and accepting connections on. Required if services does not exist and protocol is tcp.

options.name: http
options.description: Configuration for HTTP and HTTPS services

options.name: listen_port
options.description: The port the service listens on, i.e. the port users can connect to.

options.name: load_balancer
options.description: Name or ID of the Hetzner Cloud Load Balancer the service belongs to

options.name: protocol
options.description: Protocol of the service. Required if Load Balancer does not exist.
